payload.acceptance_criteria:
When an ignored folder under a hidden include directory holds a type error, pyright-hidden passes.
When a tracked file under a hidden include directory holds a type error, pyright-hidden still fails and names it.
payload.description:
## Context
When a checkout holds git-ignored local folders under a hidden directory, I want pyright-hidden to check only paths that a commit can carry, so local evidence cannot fail a destination verify.

## Finding
2026-11-16: basicly verify --mode full in the base checkout failed pyright-hidden-linux with 122 errors, all in eight ignored, untracked folders under .basicly/usage/ (earlier session evidence). .scripts/check_hidden_types.py runs pyright with include '.' on each hidden include directory. This blocked the landing tool's required destination verify. CI does not see these folders.
payload.title: Check only tracked paths in pyright-hidden so ignored local folders cannot fail verify

payload.acceptance_criteria:
When a merged lane holds only git-ignored folders and its own ledger redirect, basicly worktree cleanup removes it without --force.
When a lane holds a real untracked or modified file, cleanup still refuses and names it.
payload.description:
## Context
When a lane is landed and clean, I want basicly worktree cleanup to remove it without --force, so a clean lane never needs a discard flag that the auto-mode classifier refuses.

## Finding
Reported by the handily session via the Orchestrator, 2026-11-16, on a landed clean lane: git status --short shows only '?? .basicly/ledger/redirect'. 'basicly worktree cleanup statemark' exits 1 with "worktree 'statemark' has uncommitted changes; commit them or pass force to discard:" followed by 15 lines of git-ignored generated folders such as '!! mods/handily-board/.claude-plugin/types/handily-workitems/'. The tool counts ignored entries (!!) and its own redirect file as uncommitted work, so every clean lane needs --force.

## Fix
Ignore !! entries and the tool's own .basicly/ledger/redirect when cleanup checks for uncommitted work. Not claimed and not built.
payload.title: Let worktree cleanup ignore git-ignored files and its own redirect file

payload.acceptance_criteria:
When the setup of either test is slowed by 50 ms per step, both tests give the same result as without the delay.
When the claim ignores its deadline, each test still fails.
payload.description:
## Context
When CI runs on a slow runner, I want the joined-claim tests to give the same result, so a gate fails only for a real fault.

## Finding
2026-11-16, while fixing test_a_join_with_almost_no_budget_refuses_once_without_spinning with an injected clock (2fbab0dd), two more tests in tests/test_kit_vault_claim_burst.py were found to depend on wall-clock time:
- test_a_joined_claim_reserves_time_for_takeover_inside_a_short_deadline: claim(deadline=2) and assert spent < 2.
- test_a_live_sharer_finishes_after_takeover_without_lost_or_duplicate_events: deadline=10 and deadline=2, with paused.wait(timeout=5) and takeover_pushed.wait(timeout=8).
The burst test's spent < 30 is wall time by design and stays.
Both failed in CI 43926117616, but that run also had the double kit load, so a slow-runner failure of their own is not proven.

## Fix
Inject the claim clock (claim() takes ticks) where the budget, not the runner, decides. Keep every assertion. Not claimed and not built.
payload.title: Remove wall-clock dependence from two joined-claim tests in the burst test file
